description: Every time there’s another mass shooting, we go through the same pattern.Shock. Grief. Anger.Then nothing changes.I’ve stood in the pulpit the Sunday after one of those tragedies, trying to find words. I’ve talked to parents who are afraid to send their kids to school. I’ve watched teachers turn their classrooms into fortresses.And I’ve asked the same question a lot of people are asking:Why are we still living like this?I’m running for Congress because we should be free to feel safe in our schoo
